topic: Macao insurance and financial-services regulation and supervision

items.title: 未獲許可從事借貸活動 (Unauthorised entities offering lending)
items.grounded_note: Public notice (Chinese page) from AMCM warning that nearby-region lending companies soliciting Macao residents via social media are not licensed to carry out financial activities in the Macao SAR; reminds public to use AMCM‑listed licensed institutions and cites penalties under Law No. 13/2023 (financial system legal framework).

items.title: 銀行及支付機構短訊不得含超連結 金管局籲市民提防勿點擊 (Banks and payment institutions: SMS must not contain hyperlinks — AMCM warns public not to click)
items.grounded_note: AMCM statement (Chinese page) advising the public about phishing via SMS with hyperlinks; reiterates AMCM requirement that banks and payment institutions must not embed links in SMS and advises steps for consumers (contact institution, consult Judiciary Police anti‑fraud tools/hotlines).
